item.title: Heat From France’s Wildfires Creates a ‘Fire Cloud,’ or Pyrocumulonimbus
item.description: A pyrocumulonimbus — a thundercloud created by intense heat — is a phenomenon that can spark new blazes and is “unprecedented in France,” officials said.
item.dc:creator: Claire Moses

item.title: How the Iran-Backed Houthis Cornered Saudi Arabia Into a New Conflict
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has seized on a vulnerable moment for neighboring Saudi Arabia, which does not want another war. The group hopes to force political concessions in Yemen that could give it more authority and more access to resources.
item.dc:creator: Vivian Nereim and Shuaib Almosawa

item.title: Should We Make Daylight Saving Time Permanent?
item.description: More light at the day’s end comes at a price: much later winter sunrises across much of the U.S. Scientists have documented consequences for public health and the economy.
